seed_world_description: I have nothing to tell you. You already know everything about me. After all, you took me from the nursery yourself... And other than that, I don't remember anything. Although... there were some people in lab coats who did some experiments on me. And I don't remember which ones...
seed_family_description: And I don't remember my parents... Did I even have any?! Or am I something from a test tube? Ah, Master? Tell me a secret!...
seed_occupation_description: ... And anyway, why do you need me like this... I don't know anything about myself and I can't do anything. It makes me sick to look at myself. Fat is growing like yeast... My skin is covered in some kind of feathers and scales... Am I a chicken or something?... ... Seriously?! Don't make me laugh! All that's left is to lay eggs!... Ouch!... The egg is crawling!... What this all means!!!... ...Ko-ko! Ko-ko! Ko-ko!
